svg.title: @dileepadev - AI engineer
svg.desc: The @dileepadev lockup, AI Engineer, and the line I develop followed by agentic AI systems, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, MCP servers and tools, eval suites, production AI backends, typed one at a time with a line under each saying what it involves. On the right, a link to dileepa.dev and six pillars for agents, LLM apps, retrieval, MCP, evals, production, each lit while its phrase is on screen.
